AN ORDINANCE TO ESTABLISH A TEMPORARY MORATORIUM ON SEWER CONNECTIONS; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

WHEREAS, pursuant to the Act incorporating the Town of Pine Mountain, as amended and O.C.G.A. Sections 36-34-5 and 36-35-3, the Mayor and Council are authorized to establish rights, rules, regulations, and ordinances as may be necessary for the operation of the Town’s water and sewer system as they deem proper for the general welfare of the inhabitants of the Town of Pine Mountain.

WHEREAS, heavy rains in recent months and at other times have inhibited the Town’s ability to treat wastewater from its sewer system and its wastewater treatment system is in danger of not being capable of properly treating the current volume of wastewater it is receiving from current sewer connections; and

WHEREAS, the Town recognizes the necessity that a temporary moratorium on additional sewer connections is advisable to allow the Town to construct improvements necessary to handle additional wastewater.

NOW, THEREFORE, THE MAYOR AND TOWN COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN HEREBY ORDAIN AND IT IS HEREBY ORDAINED BY AUTHORITY OF SAME AS
23: connections from all new industries and new commercial and residential developments. Provided further, all existing sewer use customers will be limited under this moratorium to a maximum monthly flow of wastewater not greater than their average monthly flow of wastewater to the Town’s sewer system during the past six months plus ten percent. This moratorium shall not apply to single family residential connections not otherwise a part of a new residential development.
